34 #define RUCI_SFR_READ RUCI_NUM_SFR_READ, ruci_elmt_type_sfr_read, ruci_elmt_num_sfr_read

43 typedef struct ruci_para_sfr_read_s
44 {

46  uint8_t sub_header;
47  uint16_t length;
48  uint8_t addr;
49 } ruci_para_sfr_read_t;

51 /* User should provide msg buffer is greater than sizeof(ruci_para_sfr_read_t) */
52 #define SET_RUCI_PARA_SFR_READ(msg, addr_in) \
53  do{ \
54  ((ruci_para_sfr_read_t *)msg)->ruci_header.u8 = RUCI_SF_HOST_CMD_HEADER; \
55  ((ruci_para_sfr_read_t *)msg)->sub_header = RUCI_CODE_SFR_READ; \
56  ((ruci_para_sfr_read_t *)msg)->length = RUCI_PARA_LEN_SFR_READ; \
57  ((ruci_para_sfr_read_t *)msg)->addr = addr_in; \
58  }while(0)
